description: Set the current app for this conversation so later tools default to it without repeating `project`. Behaves as session state: it persists until you call this again and applies to every subsequent tool call. Returns { currentProject } — the project id now in effect. Use when the user says 'switch to <app>' or names an app to focus on; call list_projects first for valid ids. No effect with a single-app key (the project is fixed).

project.description: The project id to make current, copied from list_projects (e.g. 'proj_3a8f137bccdd4f').

name: use_project
title: Select the current app
